scope: only the 32 completed variants of the existing eight pilot groups
measurement_only: nonempty observation channels; every operation has identically zero task utility
history_semantics: complete reset-to-first-reset batches; joint routes included; no intervening task or idle batches
deduplication: posterior,remaining,resource within variant; expand separately at each reachable depth
failure_rule: closure cap makes variant incomplete; label cap remains unresolved; no retries or cap increases
interpretation: report adaptive-state and group counts, new/missed versus old collector, and fold/depth breakdown; no inference beyond depth-two measurement-only reachability
